checked_decisions.finding: 'Gainer Sanga, returning to base.' matches the source radio call exactly; correct tail line for resource 2821010 before the Power Golem block begins.

Grandiose, self-important register ('I am Asuham Boone!', 'my subordinate', 'this I' emphasis) matches the locked personality in character_names_021.json ('Obsessive; descends into homicidal madness'; role: high-ranking Saint Regan officer pursuing Gain). Terminology 'Power Golem', 'Saint Regan' consistent throughout.

'London IMA' for ロンドン・イマ is not yet present in terms_028.json or any locked glossary file, so it remains a proposal; the rendering (acronym capitalized) is reasonable and internally consistent with the one other 'IMA' reference researched. Recommend orchestrator lock.

Bare ゴレーム ('Golem') correctly reuses the locked unit name 'Power Golem' (unit_names_014_b.json, slot 347) rather than an unrelated wiki romanization; consistent with project policy that a locked spelling wins.

Idiom 'やせてもかれてもセントレーガン' rendered as 'Even down on our luck, we're still Saint Regan' preserves the self-deprecating-but-proud sense rather than a flat literal 'thin or withered'; verified against source.
Unnamed subordinate addressed with 'you'/'your'; no gender or identity invented, consistent with Asuham's role directing subordinates.

Source uses third-person 'あいつら' (them/those guys) in 15334-15335 but the translation renders the continuation as direct second-person ('All you know is turf...'). Reviewed against the immediately following row 15336 ('きたのか！この悪党どもが！' -> 'You came! You villains!'), which is itself a third-person-grammar exclamation naturally rendered as direct address; the shift is judged a defensible rhetorical choice (addressing the very group being described) rather than a wrong-addressee reversal, so left unchanged. Flagged below as an uncertainty rather than a fix.

uncertainties.issue: 'それがあいつらのやり方か？ / 縄張り意識しかないとは、まるで、時間までが凍り付いているようだな。' uses third-person 'they' (あいつら) but the target 'All you know is turf, like even time itself has frozen for you' addresses 'you' directly. Both readings are plausible for a battle bark (commenting on vs. taunting the group in view); left as-is since it is not a clear reversal, but calling it out as a genuine judgment call rather than a clean pass.
